title: Targets
description: Websites and applications scanned by Stellar

help.url: The site's home page. It is scanned from outside, unauthenticated and harmlessly.
help.code_path: Must be inside the allowed folders ('code_roots' in the configuration).
help.code_zip: If the code is not on the Stellar server. It is unzipped, scanned and deleted.
help.authorized: I confirm this website or code is ours or we have written permission to scan it. Without this mark it is not scanned.
help.repo_url: Public or private. Private ones need a read-only token in the configuration ('git_tokens'). It is downloaded on each scan and deleted.

confirm.scan: It will be scanned now. A website may take a minute; code, depending on size. Continue?

flash.scan_failed: The scan could not be done.

errors.url_invalid: The website address is not valid.
errors.source_required: Enter the code folder or upload a .zip.
errors.repo_invalid: The repository address must be https://server/owner/repo.
